name: Shock Troops: The Upsets of World Cup 2026
angle: The giant-killings of World Cup 2026: debutants Cabo Verde held European champions Spain, Ecuador and Turkiye downed the hosts, and both Germany and the Netherlands were dumped out on penalties in the Round of 32. Curated and de-duplicated from the daily World Cup quiz series.
